newsitem.title: USA: Package bomb injures California attorney - FBI.
newsitem.headline: Package bomb injures California attorney - FBI.

text.p: A California attorney was seriously injured on Monday by a bomb that was wrapped up like a holiday present, the FBI said.
The attorney, who was not immediately identified, found the package outside his office in Santa Cruz, said George Grotz, FBI spokesman in San Francisco.
"He took that into his office and proceeded to open it up, and as he did so, it exploded," Grotz said.
Grotz said the victim suffered serious hand wounds and facial lacerations and was taken to Stanford Medical Centre.
The bomb squad from the Santa Cruz County sheriff's office was called to the scene to make sure there were no other explosives, a sheriff's spokesman said.
